# litellm_secret_backend (Resource)

Mounts the LiteLLM secrets engine and writes its connection config. The plugin must already be registered in the plugin catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "litellm_secret_backend" "litellm" {
  path        = "litellm"
  description = "LiteLLM virtual keys"
  base_url    = "https://litellm.example.com"
  master_key  = var.litellm_master_key
}

variable "litellm_master_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the LiteLLM proxy (e.g. https://litellm.example.com).
- `master_key` (String, Sensitive) LiteLLM master key used to manage virtual keys. Write-only on the engine, so drift is not detected.
- `path` (String) Mount path for the LiteLLM secrets engine (e.g. "litellm"). Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the mount.
- `plugin` (String) Name of the plugin in the plugin catalog. Defaults to "vault-plugin-secrets-litellm". Changing this forces a new resource.
- `request_timeout_seconds` (Number) HTTP timeout in seconds for calls from the plugin to the LiteLLM proxy. Defaults to 30.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by mount path. master_key is never read back, so set it in
# configuration; the next apply rewrites it.
terraform import litellm_secret_backend.litellm litellm
```
